errors.evidence: The first pie chart incorrectly describes Universal Quantifiers as shown in light blue; it is actually in a light gray color.
The second pie chart incorrectly describes the color of Absolute Absence as light lavender/beige; it is actually a light purple shade.

The description implies a uniform arrangement of slices in descending order for the first pie chart, but it is inaccurately describing the order of Limiter (27.91%) and Negation (27.91%), which are equal.
